e.title: Porto Seguro Safe Driver Prediction
e.summary: 车险驾驶风险 Kaggle 经典竞赛：二分类风险预测基准（车险定价/UBI 数据源）
e.body: Porto Seguro Safe Driver Prediction 是 Kaggle 经典车险竞赛：预测司机一年内是否出险（二分类），巴西 Porto Seguro 提供的脱敏特征数据。对 RIAA：车险风险建模的经典基准——特征工程/不平衡分类/模型集成的标准练兵场（同 [[grab-aiforsea-safety]]、[[driver-behavior-telematics]] 的 UBI 谱系）；与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）、[[insurancerating]]（定价方法）衔接；竞赛 kernel/高分方案是课程项目与面试作品集的现成参考。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：Kaggle 竞赛页确认（车险出险二分类，Porto Seguro 数据），未实测
e.summary_en: Classic Kaggle motor-insurance competition: binary driving-risk prediction benchmark (pricing/UBI data source)
e.summary_hk: 車險駕駛風險 Kaggle 經典競賽：二分類風險預測基準（車險定價/UBI 數據源）
e.body_en: Porto Seguro Safe Driver Prediction is a classic Kaggle motor-insurance competition: predicting whether a driver files a claim within a year (binary classification) on anonymised features from Porto Seguro (Brazil). For RIAA: the classic benchmark for motor-risk modelling — a standard training ground for feature engineering/imbalanced classification/ensemble methods (sharing the UBI lineage of [[grab-aiforsea-safety]] and [[driver-behavior-telematics]]); connects to [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing) and [[insurancerating]] (pricing methods); competition kernels and top solutions are ready references for course projects and interview portfolios.
e.body_hk: Porto Seguro Safe Driver Prediction 是 Kaggle 經典車險競賽：預測司機一年內是否出險（二分類），巴西 Porto Seguro 提供的脱敏特徵數據。對 RIAA：車險風險建模的經典基準——特徵工程/不平衡分類/模型集成的標準練兵場（同 [[grab-aiforsea-safety]]、[[driver-behavior-telematics]] 的 UBI 譜系）；與 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定價）、[[insurancerating]]（定價方法）銜接；競賽 kernel/高分方案是課程項目與面試作品集的現成參考。
